name: svg-navigator---chrome-extension
description: SVG Navigator is a browser extension that adds infinite zoom and panning to existing SVG files on the web.

scripts.start:chrome: bun run prebuild && webextension-toolbox dev chrome --src src
scripts.start:safari: bun run prebuild && webextension-toolbox dev safari --src src
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:unit && bun scripts/bright-builds-check.ts all
scripts.build:chrome: bun run prebuild && webextension-toolbox build chrome --src src
scripts.build:firefox: bun run prebuild && webextension-toolbox build firefox --src src
scripts.build:safari: bun run prebuild && webextension-toolbox build safari --src src
scripts.build:all: bun run build:chrome && bun run build:firefox && bun run build:safari
scripts.build:safari-app: bun run build:safari && xcodebuild -project 'safari/SVG Navigator.xcodeproj' -scheme 'SVG Navigator' -configuration Release -derivedDataPath .build/safari-app -allowProvisioningUpdates build
scripts.zip:source: zip -r svg-navigator-source.zip src scripts eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json package.json bun.lock bunfig.toml README.md web-ext-config.mjs LICENSE.txt -x "**/node_modules/*"
scripts.build:dev: bun run prebuild && webextension-toolbox build chrome --src src -t .build/chrome -o dev-chrome && webextension-toolbox build firefox --src src -t .build/firefox -o dev-firefox
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:dev && bun test test/e2e

author: Peter Ryszkiewicz
